status: current; every model input of v4 unchanged; adds the behaviour definitions of docs/experiments_plan_v5.md (D74)
replaces: v4, kept in config/emotion_spec_v4.json; v5 only adds the behaviour section
reason: new user-level and time-causal features for the week-7 behaviour experiments must be fixed before any result (D74)

evidence.rule: D30 (weight, t), D32 (features) in docs/decisions.md; D46, D47, D48, D49 (SemEval validation); D53, D58, D62 (fusion score)

labelling.rule: 6-class group of the max raw score over the 25 non-neutral labels without approval and disapproval if >= t, else neutral (v2b, D38)
labelling.use: reporting and validation only; never a model feature
labelling.caution: Chosen on 250 trial headlines; kappa is fair and the confidence intervals of v2, v2b and v2c overlap, so the data do not separate these rules. Validated on headlines only.

fusion.normalisation: per-impression min-max of base and emotion scores

excluded.go_pct_curiosity: sign flips on valid (fit dz +0.016, valid dz -0.054)
excluded.go_pct_desire: sign flips on valid (fit dz +0.022, valid dz -0.069)
excluded.go_emotionality: sign flips on valid (fit dz +0.109, valid dz -0.047)
excluded.go_vad_arousal: sign flips on valid (fit dz -0.147, valid dz +0.053)
excluded.nrc_anticipation: sign flips on valid (fit dz +0.017, valid dz -0.024)
excluded.vad_dominance: sign flips on valid (fit dz -0.139, valid dz +0.009)
excluded.go_intensity: sign flips on valid (fit dz +0.149, valid dz -0.036); kept as a column in news_emotion_features_v2.parquet (Q05)
excluded.cong_six_negkl: sign flips on valid (fit dz -0.025, valid dz +0.115)
excluded.cong_valence_absdist: sign flips on valid (fit dz -0.026, valid dz +0.037)
excluded.vad_arousal: not significant at both levels on fit
excluded.cong_*_otheruser / cong_*_userspecific: analysis controls (random other user), not model features

confirmation_rule.rule: D48 in docs/decisions.md; replaces the hand-label rule D29
confirmation_rule.any_change: new file config/emotion_spec_v5.json + decision log entry + test hash entry

consistency.secondary: mean cosine to the centroid (1 - dispersion)
consistency.groups: tertiles of fit impressions with 2+ items; else no_history

same_day.source: the user's clicks in strictly earlier impressions of the same calendar day
same_day.value_rule: chosen a < 1 must beat a = 1 on covered valid impressions, p < 0.05

drift.score: mean pairwise cosine of the last 5 minus cosine(mean of last 5, mean of older)

exposure.definition: strictly earlier impressions (any part, by timestamp) that showed the item
exposure.cut: new = 0; few = 1 to Q; many > Q; Q = median exposure of fit rows with exposure > 0

residual.definition: item vector minus its category mean over items shown in fit impressions
